snippet.title: Chance - A Property-Trading Deckbuilder
snippet.description:
The property-trading deckbuilder. Chance is strange, dusty board game where you steal land from the bourgeoisie, bankrupt the proletariat, break the rules with unfair chance cards, and discover strategies worthy of an antitrust lawsuit.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4293810/Chance/

Try the demo on Itch: https://joebain.itch.io/chance
